title: The Amusement Park
content: Last night I went to the amusement park. I pushed the wheelchair of an elderly gent that I have never met. I'm sorry you didn't have a good time. The park was very large, lots of people. I only went on one "ride", a walk through with a lot vingettes. Lots of flags/pennents, large and beautiful pavillions of various ages of architecture. One of the sellers sites was "purposely" rude and entertaining.
